card.name: Digits in citation page numbers
card.fires_on: Single digits inside page numbers or page ranges in scholarly citations, after 'p.', 'pp.', a volume colon, or a reporter name like F.3d.

modes.label: Legal reporter pages
modes.description: Digits of the first page number after a court reporter volume such as F.3d.
modes.example: Smithkline Beecham Corp. v. Apotex, 365 F.3d <<1>>306 (Fed. Cir.

modes.label: Book page numbers
modes.description: Digits after 'p.' or 'pp.' in footnotes citing books or articles.
modes.example: Key Studies in Psychology (1994) p. <<3>>04–5 - R.
